newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Forint ends down vs dlr, BUBOR futures open on BCE.
newsitem.headline: Forint ends down vs dlr, BUBOR futures open on BCE.

text.p: The Hungarian forint closed a shade weaker against the dollar in what dealers said was a day dominated by range trading and some focus on the yen.
"There were some arbitrage deals in yen as it moved during the day, but otherwise it was a quiet day," said Peter Luczo of Inter-Europa Bank.
The Hungarian unit closed at 153.90 to the U.S. unit compared with its opening of 153.83/87, trading throughout the day on the National Bank of Hungary's bid.
On the Budapest Commodity Exchange, Budapest Interbank Offered Rate (BUBOR) one- and three-month futures began trading.
